title: Policy Authorization Service; Stage 3
tagline: AF influence on session policy via Policy Authorization
summary: TS 29.514 defines the Npcf_PolicyAuthorization service where an Application Function (AF) can influence session management policy. In the broader 29.512 story, AF sessions may affect PCC rules and QoS that appear in SmPolicyDecision.
defines: AF-provided service information and media components
PCF use of AF input when deriving session policy
Events subscription for application session changes
whyItMatters: Not every PDU session is AF-neutral. When an application requests specific QoS or routing, Policy Authorization is how that influence reaches the PCF — and ultimately shapes what SMF receives in SmPolicyDecision.

entryPoints.description: AF creates application session context influencing policy.

entryPoints.description: PCF may incorporate AF session info into SmPolicyDecision.

entryPoints.description: Session procedure where influenced policy is applied.
